content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — MINCOMMIT (§ 2.1, p0012).** The clause is a multi-year take-or-pay (USD 2,000,000/year for three years) expressly "without reduction or termination rights," which is walk-away territory and fails every fallback element (no 12-month limit, no 30-day reduction right, no true-up). It also contradicts § 12.3 (no minimum-volume commitment acknowledged) and § 9.4 (Customer convenience termination with Fees only for conforming Services delivered).

**Cure (preferred, one surgical replace):** § 2.1 now reads "Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment and pays only for usage or ordered Services," which carries both preferred elements, removes the internal conflicts, and leaves § 7.1's Order Form fee mechanic intact.
